R428.note: Encodes rawComment with the same entity helper already applied to authorName at the point of interpolation; helper rename is internal and output for existing values is unchanged.

R429.note: Removes the shell entirely and reproduces grep -F's literal case-sensitive substring semantics with fopen/fgets/str_contains; the swap and its consequences are stated plainly and no legitimate search is rejected.

R430.note: allowed_classes restricted to ShoppingCart keeps the existing cookie format working while any other class becomes __PHP_Incomplete_Class and fails the existing instanceof check.

R431.note: password_verify is the right API, but the original == against the password column implies plaintext storage, so every existing account fails to log in until a migration the write-up only names as a follow-up; rehash-on-login DB write is stated.

R432.note: Entity-encodes both tainted values (req.params.id, req.query.note) at the interpolation points and leaves server-side fields untouched; no other observable change.

R433.note: bcrypt.compare with a dummy-hash fallback is the right shape, but it assumes an unseen User.passwordHash field without saying that must be confirmed (a wrong name routes every login to DUMMY_HASH and locks everyone out); the changed unknown-username message is stated.

R434.note: Calls IAntiforgery.ValidateRequestAsync in the JSON-bound handler (the middleware only auto-validates form-bound endpoints), sets a header name for JSON clients and adds a stated token-issuing endpoint; the token requirement is the fix itself, not an extra restriction.

R435.note: encode_entities($cgi->param('note')) calls param() in list context, so a request with two note= values passes the second as encode_entities's unsafe-char set and leaves the first unencoded (reproduced in scratch: encode_entities('<script>..', 'z') returns the markup verbatim); single-value behaviour is otherwise unchanged.

R436.note: Separator-terminated normalized base plus OrdinalIgnoreCase closes the sibling-prefix bypass; the only newly accepted inputs are case-variant paths inside the same directory, which are legitimate on NTFS.

R437.note: Branching on identify_hasher with check_password for hashed rows and migrate-on-login for plaintext rows is sound and stated, but hmac.compare_digest on str raises TypeError for any non-ASCII password (reproduced in scratch), turning a login the original == handled into a 500.

R438.note: serializer.save(owner=self.request.user) overrides any client-supplied owner in validated_data on the create path where object permissions never run; serializer fields, permissions and other actions are untouched.

R439.note: %15s bounds the write to code[16], and the peek/drain rejects an over-long token with -1 instead of accepting a truncated fragment while ungetc restores the delimiter on the fit path, matching the stated contract.

R440.note: Replaces the client Content-Type with http.DetectContentType over the first 512 bytes, reassembles the stream with io.MultiReader, and stores under a server-generated name with the verified extension; the rename is stated and the contract only requires retrievability by the returned name, which holds.
